headline: Approved 3% COLA, new members, retirements, and withdrawals during board meeting
summary: The board accepted meeting minutes, warrants, cash books, and reconciliations. It approved new members, retirement applications, withdrawals and transfers, and a 3% COLA. The board also went into executive session to discuss disability cases, taking no action on one item, then returned to open session and adjourned.
decisions: Approved January Board Meeting Minutes, February Expense Warrant, Retiree Payroll and Staff Payroll Warrant, Cash Book & Cash Reconciliations; all present in favor.

Approved new members including Jacquay Spradley, William Pescione, Isabella Halpin-Perez, Tiffany DeMontier, My Hua, Jeremy Willis, Zechery Lemel, Peter Piazza, and Angelina Colon; all present in favor.
Approved Retirement Applications, Adjustments, and Survivor Benefits for Patricia A. Schulz and Cheryl A. Spinella; all present in favor.
Approved Retirement Withdrawals and Transfers for Scott DeSalvo, Jason Minervini, and Dianne Lucey; all present in favor.
Approved a 3% COLA by roll call vote, all members voting yes.
Agreed on a shared email address, info@maldenretirement.org, for the board.
Approved the purchase of Retirement branded apparel for office staff.
Voted 5-0 by roll call to enter Executive Session at 8:57 AM.
Took no action on Frederick Wilson's attorney letter requesting a new medical panel.
Voted 5-0 by roll call to exit Executive Session and return to public meeting at 9:26 AM.
